status: Downloaded real public historical market data, but data audit failed for exact buy-and-hold reconstruction.

available.api_auth: No API key required for successful public requests

semantics.plain_stock_splits: AAPL confirms close and dividends split adjusted; split_cumprod can undo ordinary splits. 2010-10-01 AAPL close10.09,split_cumprod1/28. 2012-08-09 dividend0.094642857=$2.65/28.
semantics.noncash_distributions: Some spinoffs/class-stock distributions are represented as divs while historical closes are ALREADY adjusted, so naive (close+divs)/prior_close materially overstates returns. split_cumprod does not encode all those adjustments.
semantics.membership: Do not use is_liquid as point-in-time membership: tested 2010-10-01 has80members with TSLA/FTNT/DXCM before their inclusion dates. Many old members have all-zero flags.

blocking_issues.issue: Ticker reuse and historical identity errors
examples: ALTR old Altera history labelled Altair
GENZ historic stock and reused ETF ticker
FISV two largely overlapping price histories
FB old Meta versus new ETF
blocking_issues.resolution: Use stable source IDs and audited date ranges, never merge by ticker or trust current name alone.

not_valid: This dataset alone is insufficient for exact after-tax retain-former-members backtest. Do not silently drop terminal names, assume lastclose persists, use current constituents backdated, treat all divs as taxablecash, or call unadjusted capproxy indexweights.
possible_repair: Requires independently verified membership+weights, corporate-action ledger for cash/stock merger/spinoff/rename/cancellation, ordinarycash dividend series on compatible units, and accurate price series. Preserve taxbasis allocation and forced-realization timing.
